notes.text: HTTP clients make REST calls to PUBLIC_API (FastAPI); web (Next.js 14) makes REST calls to INTERACTION (Flask).
INTERACTION (Flask) reads + writes PostgreSQL, enqueues SQS tasks and starts Temporal workflows.
Temporal workflows read + write PostgreSQL, enqueue SQS tasks and make API calls to CRM + workspace APIs.
